name: What measurements should I take before buying a bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: What measurements should I take before buying a bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before purchasing a replacement vanity, measure the total available width, depth, and height, accounting for door swings and drawer clearance against showers or toilets. Next, measure the exact position of your plumbing rough-ins: record the height of the drain pipe and the spread of the hot and cold supply lines from the floor and center wall. Many pre-fabricated vanities come with fixed interior shelves or pre-cut drawer backs that can collide with existing pipes, forcing you to modify drawers or alter plumbing if dimensions are not confirmed in advance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure width, depth, and height clearances, along with the precise height and spread of your water supply lines and drain pipe relative to the cabinet drawers.
